description: Plan 09 of the Ralph pipeline: a first-class Model Context Protocol server at tools/overview-mcp/ that exposes 10 typed RPC tools over the Ralph overview state (snapshot, recommendations, blockers, journal, crew sessions, transcripts) so other agents can call typed tools instead of parsing files. Reuses shared libraries under scripts/lib/ (derive-next-command, crews-cross-walk, work-on-via-crew, sync-core, resolve-config, atomic-write) and adds one additive helper (appendJournalNote) plus a sibling .d.mts for work-on-via-crew.mjs.

planReviewContext.description: Calling runWorkOnViaCrew() from the MCP server would corrupt the stdio JSON-RPC stream. runWorkOnViaCrew (scripts/lib/work-on-via-crew.mjs lines 21 and 61) defaults its stdout parameter to process.stdout and writes a 'Spawned <crew>/<member>...' confirmation line on success. The MCP server reserves stdout for the protocol stream. The plan must explicitly pass stdout: process.stderr (or a sink that forwards to stderr) when delegating to runWorkOnViaCrew.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Pass { stdout: process.stderr } (or a logger that writes to stderr) when calling runWorkOnViaCrew so the spawn confirmation line never lands on the JSON-RPC stdout channel.
